title: Reading Drill — An Experiment with Painted Signs
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: An Experiment with Painted Signs
passages.body:
**A** A shopkeeper tested painted signs in two colours. To stop position affecting the result, signs were exchanged between the two windows every morning.

**B** The signs with darker lettering were noticed more often at a distance. In both positions, however, letters disappeared behind reflections when the sun was low.

**C** A printer proposed a matt finish and larger spaces between words. The shopkeeper tried the finish first to measure the effect of a single change.
